decisions.decision: Research before planning Phase 3 (user chose 'Research first' at the research gate)
decisions.rationale: The phase introduces four net-new integration surfaces — Android WorkManager, iOS UNUserNotificationCenter, a fourth expect/actual pair, and schema v4 — where an unverified API assumption would surface only at execution time.

decisions.decision: One database instance per process via a commonMain DatabaseProvider object, initialised from an Android Application and from MainViewController on iOS
decisions.rationale: SQLDelight's listener registry lives on the driver instance. A CoroutineWorker that built its own VehiCareDatabase would write successfully but never wake the UI's Flows, which would present as randomly stale reminders. The research also found startKoin is called nowhere, so Koin cannot serve the worker.

decisions.decision: Delete the getOrNull<DriverFactory>() fallback in di/AppModule.kt as part of plan 03-01
decisions.rationale: Pattern mapping found that fallback throws on Android today, so it is dead-but-dangerous code once DatabaseProvider exists. Leaving it would offer a second, broken path to a driver.

decisions.decision: Add exactly one dependency: androidx.work:work-runtime:2.12.0 (never the -ktx artifact)
decisions.rationale: The -ktx artifact has been empty since 2.9.0 and would add a misleading coordinate. Every other library is already pinned in gradle/libs.versions.toml, which is the authoritative source.

decisions.decision: 03-UI-SPEC.md remains the design source of truth; research reports blockers instead of redesigning
decisions.rationale: The UI contract is approved (6/6 dimensions, no open findings) and fixes every rendered element, string, spacing value and colour consumer. Research confirmed no contract is blocked, including the palette-locked Switch and the single-select chip semantics limitation.

context_notes: Planning was stopped by an infrastructure failure, not a design problem: the gsd-planner subagent died with `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND opencode.ai` after writing four plans. Those plans are complete and were inspected before commit — task blocks balance, every task has read_first and acceptance_criteria, and the final refinements (moving ReminderRow into ReminderStatus.kt, adding evaluateAll as the single rule-to-baseline join, splitting ReminderCopy into pure SentenceSpec decisions plus suspend and composable resolvers) are coherent. What exists covers the data foundation (03-01, wave 1), the pure calculation core (03-02, wave 2), persistence + copy + notification identity (03-03, wave 2) and the Reminders list (03-04, wave 3). What is missing is the editor/Detail slice, the dashboard slice and the delivery slice — so REM-01/REM-02/REM-03 are claimed and REM-04/DSH-01 are not. Nothing has been executed: no code, schema, manifest or Gradle file has changed. The biggest execution risk is the duplicate-database failure mode described in 03-01; the second is that iOS notification work cannot be verified in CI and must be an autonomous:false manual step.
